title: Ala. Admin. Code r. 660-2-2-.10, -.27, -.31, -.32; 660-2-4-.10, -.19, 660-2-4-A
what_it_sets: Family Assistance: payment = department's payment standard (set 'based on the amount of funds available', varies by family size; no dollar table in the current rules -- Attachment 660-2-2-.31 'Standards for FA families' repealed 9/21/18) minus rounded net income; minimum grant $10; first-month proration. State Supplementation: amount depends on kind of care, subject to funds; must be an SSI recipient; Attachment 660-2-4-.19a special needs amounts (e.g. nursing care supplement $60, personal care supplement A $60 / B $56, foster-care supplement $110, cerebral palsy treatment center $196); .19b nursing-home basic requirements; .26a 1995 FBR chart (reference only).
